mapper.select: SELECT agent_id, tool_id, access_scope, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_tool_user_policy WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY tool_id
SELECT agent_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_user_access_policy WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT agent_id, tool_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_tool_user_access_policy WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY tool_id, user_id

SELECT agent_id FROM agent_tool_policy UNION SELECT agent_id FROM agent_user_policy UNION SELECT agent_id FROM agent_tool_user_policy UNION SELECT agent_id FROM agent_user_access_policy UNION SELECT agent_id FROM agent_tool_user_access_policy ORDER BY agent_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_user_policy (agent_id, access_scope) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{accessScope}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_scope = VALUES(access_scope), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
INSERT INTO agent_tool_user_policy (agent_id, tool_id, access_scope) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{toolId}, #{accessScope})
INSERT INTO agent_tool_user_access_policy (agent_id, tool_id, user_id) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{toolId}, #{userId})
